name: winadsec

operations.discover: Unauthenticated DC fingerprint: ports, SMB, LDAP rootDSE, OS, domain
operations.users: Enumerate domain users via LDAP or SAMR RID brute
operations.shares: SMB share enum with READ/WRITE tests
operations.passpol: Domain password policy (lockout threshold, min-length, complexity)
operations.kerberoast: Find SPN accounts, request TGS hashes (hashcat $krb5tgs$)
operations.asreproast: Dump AS-REP hashes for no-preauth users (hashcat $krb5asrep$)
operations.vulncheck: Zerologon, PetitPotam, NoPac, MachineAccountQuota, AD CS, SMBv1, signing
operations.bloodhound: Run bloodhound-python, output BH-compatible JSON zip
operations.loot: Scrape shares for cred files, GPP cpassword, SSH keys, .kdbx, configs
operations.exec: Remote command via WMI (impacket-wmiexec or native)
operations.privesc_check: PowerShell privesc audit with AMSI bypass: unquoted services, writable binaries, UAC, AlwaysInstallElevated, stored creds, PATH hijack, autoruns
operations.uac_bypass: HKCU registry hijack → auto-elevating binary (fodhelper/eventvwr/wsreset) → arbitrary elevated payload
operations.lsa_fix: UAC bypass → set LimitBlankPasswordUse=0 (fixes blank-password SMB auth)
operations.persistence: Install/remove payload persistence: run_key | startup_folder | scheduled_task | service | wmi_sub | all_user
operations.sliver_spawndll: Reflective DLL injection via Sliver spawndll
operations.sliver_getsystem: Escalate to SYSTEM via Sliver getsystem
operations.sliver_whoami: Get current user context via Sliver
operations.sliver_impersonate: Impersonate logged-in user token via Sliver
operations.sliver_make_token: Create logon session with given credentials via Sliver
operations.gen_proxy_dll: Compile version.dll proxy sideloading DLL (AMSI+ETW patch + WinHTTP C2 loader + explorer.exe injection)
operations.gen_uac_dll: Compile UAC bypass DLL (fodhelper + COM IShellDispatch2 auto-elevate)
operations.gen_shellcode: Convert PE/EXE to raw shellcode via donut
operations.gen_payload: XOR-encrypt shellcode with 4-byte LE length prefix → update.bin
operations.gen_sliver: Generate Sliver implant (EXE/DLL/shellcode) via sliver-client generate
operations.gen_iso: Create delivery ISO: signed legit EXE + malicious version.dll
operations.gen_all: Full chain: Sliver implant → donut → XOR payload + proxy DLL + UAC DLL + ISO
operations.detect_malware: Scan remote Windows host for malware artifacts: WannaCry/EternalRocks/NotPetya services+registry+mutex, Ryuk backup-service kills, Emotet/TrickBot Run-key+WMI persistence, APT34/Lazarus process masquerade+signature checks, Turla WMI subscriptions, BlueHammer/UnDefend WD tamper, RedSun TieringEngineService hijack, GreenPlasma BlockedApps symlink, YellowKey FsTx payload, Cobalt Strike named pipes, SMBv1, WDigest, Credential Guard state
operations.hunt_lateral: Hunt Windows Event Log for lateral movement: logon type 3 bursts, PsExec (4624/4648/7045), WMI exec (4688), named pipe access (5145) — EternalRocks/NotPetya/Turla patterns
operations.hunt_c2: Detect C2 beaconing: unusual outbound connections, beacon-interval scheduled tasks, Credential Manager extraction, DNS TXT cache (Turla DNS C2), WDigest enabled — OperationDianxun/EternalRocks patterns
operations.hunt_defender_evade: BlueHammer+UnDefend+RedSun: detect WD signature hollowing (mpavbase.vdm size/lock/age), TieringEngineService.exe System32 hijack (RedSun cloud-tag TOCTOU LPE), REDSUN named pipe, WD RPC (UUID c503f532) fake-update traces, signature backup integrity
operations.hunt_cloud_files_eop: GreenPlasma+MiniPlasma: detect CVE-2020-17103 cloud filter race artifacts — HKCU CloudFiles BlockedApps registry symlink, DisableLockWorkstation policy abuse, cldapi.dll unusual process consumers, CTFMON section hijack residue
operations.hunt_bitlocker_bypass: YellowKey: detect BitLocker bypass trigger files — scan all drives + WinRE partition for FsTx/ (FsTxKtmLog.blf + FsTxLogContainer) in System Volume Information; check BitLocker protection status, Secure Boot, WinRE state
operations.undefend: Lock WD mpavbase.vdm + mpavbase.lkg with exclusive FileStream (no admin). Passive: blocks signature updates. Aggressive: also monitors WinDefend restart and locks engine files. mode param: passive|aggressive
operations.yellowkey_deploy: Deploy YellowKey FsTx BitLocker bypass payload to target via SMB (smb mode) or local filesystem (local mode). deploy_mode=smb|local; target_drive=C$
operations.bluehammer_exec: Upload+exec BlueHammer WD-RPC hollowing binary via SMB. Without bin_path: PowerShell prereq check (WD RPC UUID c503f532, sig version). bin_path=<FunnyApp.exe>
operations.redsun_exec: Upload+exec RedSun WD cloud-tag TOCTOU LPE via SMB → SYSTEM shell. Without bin_path: PS prereq check (RTP enabled, TieringEngineService.exe status). bin_path=<RedSun.exe>
operations.greenplasma_exec: Upload+exec GreenPlasma/MiniPlasma EoP (CVE-2020-17103 cldflt race). eop_tool=greenplasma|miniplasma (default: miniplasma). bin_path=<compiled_exe>
operations.offense_chain: Full offense chain: Stage1 UnDefend (no admin) → Stage2 LPE via eop_tool (redsun|greenplasma|miniplasma) → Stage3 persist+C2. eop_tool param selects LPE path
operations.auto: Full pipeline: discover → vulncheck → users → groups → shares → passpol → asreproast [+ kerberoast/bloodhound/privesc_check/detect_malware/hunt_lateral/hunt_c2/hunt_defender_evade/hunt_cloud_files_eop/hunt_bitlocker_bypass if creds]. detect_malware covers 12+ malware families from theZoo static analysis.

shell.description: Start OnlyShell reverse shell handler; auto-deliver payload via WMI/wmiexec if credentials are provided

params.serve: true = interactive TUI, false = headless JSON (default: true)
params.payload_type: powershell_b64 | powershell | bash_tcp | python3 | all (default: powershell_b64)

fileless_pe.description: Generate a PEloader.py that fetches and runs a DLL/EXE in memory without touching disk (pythonmemorymodule)

inject_exe.description: Bundle a malicious EXE + legitimate EXE into one PyInstaller binary; runs malware silently then launches legit app

office_macros.description: Generate Office VBA macro templates: download_exec, hidden_cmd_exec, persistence, pwsh_cmd, reverse_shell

attack_chain: 1. gen_sliver — generate Sliver EXE implant (C2 callback to c2_http_port)
2. gen_shellcode — convert to raw shellcode via donut
3. gen_payload — XOR encrypt → update.bin, serve on c2_port
4. gen_proxy_dll — compile version.dll that downloads + injects update.bin
5. gen_iso — bundle version.dll + signed OneDriveSetup.exe into ISO
6. Deliver ISO to target; user double-clicks signed EXE → DLL loads → C2 back
10. persistence — install wmi_sub or run_key for reboot survival

persistence_methods.run_key: HKCU Run key — fires on user logon, no admin needed
persistence_methods.startup_folder: User Startup folder copy — fires on logon, no admin
persistence_methods.scheduled_task: schtasks onlogon task — no admin for user scope
persistence_methods.wmi_sub: WMI EventFilter+CommandLineEventConsumer — fires 60s after boot, requires admin, stealthiest
persistence_methods.all_user: HKLM Run key — fires for every user, requires admin

uac_methods.fodhelper: ms-settings HKCU hijack → fodhelper.exe auto-elevates → PAYLOAD runs as high-integrity
uac_methods.eventvwr: mscfile HKCU hijack → eventvwr.exe → elevated payload
uac_methods.wsreset: AppX HKCU hijack → wsreset.exe → elevated payload
